summary: Numbers as players read them: grouped thousands, compact K/M/B, and ordinals.
overview: Three ways to show a number to a player rather than to a programmer. All culture-invariant, so a machine with a different locale does not silently switch thousands separators to periods and change what the UI says.
useCases: Currency and score displays that need to stay readable at large values.
Leaderboard positions (1st, 2nd, 3rd) without a special case per rank.
Compact HUD counters where a full number would not fit.

gotchas.title: ToCompact rounds, so it is not reversible
gotchas.body: 1,249 and 1,151 both display as "1.2K". Fine for a HUD, wrong for anything the player is meant to reconcile exactly, like a transaction total.

gotchas.title: Ordinals are English-only
gotchas.body: The st/nd/rd/th rule, including the 11-13 exception, is hard-coded. A localised build needs its own ordinal handling.
